lesson-intro.text: Look up in any old town and you'll spot balconies. This one has green doors, a pointed hood and a rail to lean on. Watch it come out, then step onto your own.

wall.text: The wall comes first: one big box, a little taller than wide.

slab.text: Low down, a long stone slab runs almost from side to side.

brackets.text: Two brackets hold it up. Curved on the outside, straight on the inside.

rail.text: Next, the railing, which stands in front. One level rail, with a bar down from each end.

bars.text: Six more bars between them, spaced out evenly.

doors.text: The doors stand behind the rail: up from it, across, and back down. Add a line down the middle.

hood.text: Over the doors, a flat band with a low pointed roof on top.

glass.text: A tall pane in each door, each with two short slanted lines.

knobs.text: Two round knobs just below the glass, one each side of the middle.

flower-box.text: On the right, a box a little wider at the top. A bush of five bumps sits in it.

vine-stem.text: Up the left side, a winding stem with a round flower halfway and one at the top.

leaves.text: Four leaves grow off the stem, two on each side.

yellow.text: Color the wall yellow, and the two knobs as well.

green.text: Green for the doors, the bush and the four leaves.

cream-blue.text: Cream for the slab and the hood. The glass is blue.

orange-red.text: Orange for the brackets and the box. Red for the two flowers, and three dots on the bush.

lesson-outro.text: Your balcony is ready. Who would you wave to from up there?
